narrative: CET1 capital of EUR 346.8M on EUR 1,719M of risk-weighted assets gives a CET1 ratio of 20.17% at June 2026, down 35 bps from 20.52% fully loaded at December 2025. Headroom over the 14.28% overall capital requirement is 5.9 points. Corporate and SME RWA has grown with the 13.5% loan growth, and the EUR 87M of goodwill and intangibles from Tressis and BEF is deducted from CET1.
